scripts.build: bun run generate:gds && bun --cwd site build && bun run guard:proprietary
scripts.build:site: bun run generate:gds && bun --cwd site build
scripts.check: bun run generate:gds && bun --cwd site check
scripts.cloudflare:dev: bun run build && bunx wrangler dev --config build/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy --config build/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy --config build/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env=""
